D: Marty heads to the Old West to stop Doc from being shot in the back.
P: Pour the drinks when Marty walks into the Palace Saloon and asks for water.
S: Boiled eggs pickled bright pink in spiced vinegar and beetroot, halved and served on rye with mustard, dill and flaky salt. Boil 8 eggs for 9 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Bring 250ml white vinegar, 250ml beetroot juice from a tin, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp peppercorns and 1 bay leaf to the boil. Pack the eggs and the tinned beetroot slices into a clean jar, pour over the hot brine and refrigerate for 3 days. Halve and serve on buttered rye with a dab of mustard, dill and flaky salt.
Boiled then charred corn rolled in butter, flaky salt and smoked paprika
Corn boiled 5 minutes, charred on the grill, rolled in butter, salt and smoked paprika.
Fanned apple slices with a honey cinnamon yogurt dip
Crisp apples sliced and tossed in lemon, served with Greek yoghurt whipped with honey and cinnamon for dipping.
M: smoked brisket, beans and cornbread at the 1885 festival

Salt and pepper brisket smoked low and slow until it wobbles, sliced thick with molasses baked beans and buttery skillet cornbread. Rub a 2.5kg brisket with 2 tbsp coarse salt and 2 tbsp cracked pepper. Smoke or roast at 120C for about 10 hours until it reaches 95C inside, wrapping in baking paper at 70C. Rest 1 hour, then slice. Simmer 2 drained tins cannellini beans with 1 diced onion, 3 tbsp molasses, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp mustard and 250ml stock for 45 minutes. Bake cornbread mix in a buttered hot pan at 200C for 20 minutes.
Beef chuck braised with onion, carrot and dark ale, crusty bread
Beef chuck browned, onion and carrot, a bottle of dark ale and stock, braised at 150C for 3 hours.
W: Double crust Granny Smith apple pie with cinnamon and nutmeg
Double-crust apple pie with cinnamon and nutmeg, egg wash and sugar, baked at 190C for 50 minutes.
K: Fresh lemon, ginger, honey and chili topped with ginger beer, no alcohol
Lemon, ginger, a pinch of chilli and honey topped with ginger beer, served very cold.

steps.text: Boil the corn in salted water.
Char on a hot grill, turning, until blackened in spots.
Melt the butter, roll each cob in it and sprinkle with flaky salt and smoked paprika.
Slice the apples and toss in the lemon juice so they stay white.
Whip the yoghurt with the honey and cinnamon.
Fan the apples around a bowl of the yoghurt for dipping.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled, flavour improves

steps.text: Heat the oven to 150C. Season the beef and brown in batches in a heavy ovenproof pot.
Soften the sliced onions and chopped carrots in the same pot.
Return the beef, add the ale and stock and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise in the oven until the beef falls apart.
Serve with the crusty bread for mopping up.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve warm

steps.text: Heat the oven to 190C. Peel, core and slice the apples and toss with the sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and flour.
Line a pie dish with two pastry sheets and fill with the apples.
Cover with the other two sheets, seal and trim the edges, cut a few steam vents.
Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake until deep golden and the juices bubble. Rest before slicing.

dishes.make_ahead: Juice mix up to 1 day, top with ginger beer at the table

steps.text: Juice the lemons and blitz with the ginger, honey and chilli, then strain.
Fill four glasses with ice and divide the juice between them.
Top each with very cold ginger beer.

edition.cue: Pour the drinks when Marty walks into the Palace Saloon and asks for water.

s.note: Charred corn rolled in butter, salt and smoked paprika
s.how: Boil 4 corn cobs in salted water for 5 minutes, then char on a hot grill for about 6 minutes, turning. Roll each in melted butter, about 60g in total, and sprinkle with flaky salt and smoked paprika.

s.note: Crisp apple slices with honey cinnamon yoghurt to dip
s.how: Slice 3 crisp apples and toss in the juice of a lemon so they don't brown. Whip 250g Greek yoghurt with 2 tbsp honey and half a tsp cinnamon. Fan the apples around a bowl of the yoghurt for dipping.

m.note: Beef braised in dark ale with onion and carrot
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 3 carrots in the same pot. Add 375ml dark ale and 500ml stock, cover and braise at 150C for 3 hours until the beef falls apart. Serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Double crust apple pie with cinnamon and nutmeg
w.how: Toss 1kg sliced Granny Smiths with 120g sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon, a grating of nutmeg and 2 tbsp flour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and cover with 2 more. Egg wash, sprinkle with sugar and bake at 190C for 50 minutes.

d.note: Fiery lemon, ginger and chilli topped with ginger beer
d.how: Blitz the juice of 3 lemons with a 5cm knob of grated ginger, 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of chopped red chilli, then strain. Divide between four glasses of ice and top each with about 150ml very cold ginger beer.
